source: Communications Authority of Kenya (CA) Consumer Guidelines & MNO USSD Protocols

networks.name: Safaricom
networks.checkSubscriptionsStep: Dial *100# -> Select 'My Subscriptions' or 'Promotions' -> View & Cancel active premium SMS
networks.stopAllPromoSMS: Send 'STOP' to the specific shortcode, or dial *456*9*1# to manage promotional sender IDs
networks.checkLinkedSIMsStep: Dial *106# -> Select option 1 (Check numbers registered with my ID) to identify fraudulent SIMs

networks.name: Airtel Kenya
networks.checkSubscriptionsStep: Dial *100# -> Select 'Manage My Account' -> 'My Subscriptions' -> Unsubscribe all
networks.stopAllPromoSMS: Dial *100*3# or send 'STOP' to the deduction shortcode
networks.checkLinkedSIMsStep: Dial *106# to review all MSISDN lines linked to your National ID card

networks.name: Telkom Kenya
networks.checkSubscriptionsStep: Dial *100# -> Option 4 (My Account) -> Manage Active Services
networks.stopAllPromoSMS: Send 'STOP' to the offending alphanumeric SMS shortcode
